clause_text: The Company shall indemnify and hold harmless the Client from any and all claims, damages, losses, and expenses, including attorney fees, arising out of or in any way connected with this Agreement, without any cap or limitation on liability.
risk_reason: Uncapped indemnification exposes the indemnifying party to unlimited financial liability with no ceiling.

clause_text: Each party shall indemnify the other only for direct damages caused by its own gross negligence or willful misconduct, subject to an aggregate cap equal to fees paid in the preceding 12 months.
risk_reason: Mutual indemnification with a liability cap is balanced and limits exposure.

clause_text: Vendor agrees to indemnify Client for third-party intellectual property infringement claims arising from Vendor's products, capped at two times the total contract value.
risk_reason: Capped but still a meaningful multiple of contract value; standard IP indemnity.

clause_text: This Agreement may be terminated by either party at any time, for any reason or no reason, upon thirty (30) days written notice.
risk_reason: Standard termination for convenience with reasonable notice period.

clause_text: Company may terminate this Agreement immediately, at its sole discretion, without notice or cause, and without any obligation to pay for services already rendered.
risk_reason: Immediate termination without notice and without payment for completed work is highly one-sided.

clause_text: Either party may terminate for material breach if such breach is not cured within fifteen (15) days after written notice.
risk_reason: Standard cure-period termination clause, balanced for both parties.

clause_text: Client shall be entitled to terminate this Agreement solely at its discretion, whereas Vendor may only terminate in the event of Client's non-payment for more than 90 days.
risk_reason: Asymmetric termination rights favor one party over the other.

clause_text: In no event shall either party's total liability under this Agreement exceed the total fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
risk_reason: Mutual liability cap tied to fees paid is a standard, balanced protection.

clause_text: Vendor's liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited and shall include consequential, incidental, and punitive damages.
risk_reason: Unlimited liability including consequential and punitive damages is a severe risk for the vendor.

clause_text: Neither party shall be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages, regardless of the theory of liability.
risk_reason: Standard mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages.

clause_text: Company's total liability shall not exceed the amount paid by Client in the preceding three (3) months, notwithstanding any other provision herein.
risk_reason: Short lookback period for liability cap could be limiting for damages recovery.

clause_text: The Receiving Party shall keep all Confidential Information strictly confidential and shall not disclose it to any third party for a period of five (5) years following termination of this Agreement.
risk_reason: Standard confidentiality clause with a defined, reasonable time limit.

clause_text: All information disclosed by the Disclosing Party, whether marked confidential or not, shall be deemed Confidential Information in perpetuity, with no expiration.
risk_reason: Perpetual, unbounded confidentiality obligations without a sunset clause are unusually broad.

clause_text: Confidential Information does not include information that is independently developed, publicly available, or rightfully received from a third party.
risk_reason: Standard carve-outs for confidentiality obligations are fair and expected.

clause_text: Employee agrees not to engage in any business that competes with the Company, directly or indirectly, anywhere in the world, for a period of five (5) years after termination of employment.
risk_reason: Worldwide scope combined with a five-year duration is overly broad and likely unenforceable in many jurisdictions.

clause_text: Employee shall not solicit Company's clients or employees for a period of twelve (12) months following termination, within the metropolitan area of employment.
risk_reason: Reasonable geographic and time-bound non-solicitation clause.

clause_text: This non-compete restriction shall not apply if Employee is terminated without cause.
risk_reason: Carve-out that limits enforcement of the non-compete favors the employee.

clause_text: Payment shall be due within ninety (90) days of invoice date, and Company reserves the right to change payment terms unilaterally at any time without notice.
risk_reason: Long payment cycle combined with unilateral right to change terms is unfavorable and risky.

clause_text: Client shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt. Late payments shall accrue interest at 1.5% per month.
risk_reason: Standard net-30 payment term with a reasonable late-payment interest rate.

clause_text: All fees are non-refundable under any circumstances, including in the event of Vendor's failure to deliver the contracted services.
risk_reason: Non-refundable fees even in case of non-performance is highly unfavorable to the paying party.

clause_text: Any dispute arising out of this Agreement shall be resolved through binding arbitration administered by a mutually agreed arbitrator, with each party bearing its own costs.
risk_reason: Standard binding arbitration clause with balanced cost allocation.

clause_text: All disputes shall be resolved exclusively through arbitration selected solely by Company, and Employee waives any right to a jury trial or class action participation.
risk_reason: Unilateral arbitrator selection and waiver of class action rights heavily favor one party.

clause_text: Neither party shall be liable for failure to perform its obligations if such failure results from causes beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, war, or government action.
risk_reason: Standard, narrowly defined force majeure clause covering genuine unforeseeable events.

clause_text: Company may invoke force majeure for any delay or failure whatsoever, including but not limited to market conditions, staffing issues, or budget constraints.
risk_reason: Overly broad force majeure definition effectively excuses ordinary business risk, undermining contractual reliability.

clause_text: All intellectual property created during the course of this engagement, including pre-existing IP incorporated into deliverables, shall become the exclusive property of Client.
risk_reason: Assignment of pre-existing IP alongside new work product is overreaching and risky for the vendor.

clause_text: Vendor retains ownership of pre-existing IP; Client receives a perpetual, royalty-free license to use deliverables created specifically under this Agreement.
risk_reason: Balanced IP clause that separates pre-existing IP from work-product licensing.

clause_text: Company disclaims all warranties, express or implied, including merchantability and fitness for a particular purpose, and Client accepts all deliverables as-is.
risk_reason: Full warranty disclaimer with as-is acceptance shifts all quality risk to the client.

clause_text: Vendor warrants that services will be performed in a professional manner consistent with industry standards, and will remedy any deficiencies at no additional cost within 30 days.
risk_reason: Standard professional services warranty with a reasonable remediation period.

clause_text: This Agreement automatically renews for successive one-year terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days prior to expiration.
risk_reason: Auto-renewal clauses require active monitoring to avoid unintended renewal, moderate risk if notice period is missed.

clause_text: This Agreement shall automatically and irrevocably renew for successive five-year terms unless cancelled in writing at least 365 days in advance, with cancellation subject to Company's approval.
risk_reason: Extremely long auto-renewal terms combined with approval-gated cancellation are highly restrictive.

clause_text: Client's sole and exclusive remedy for any breach of this Agreement shall be termination, and Client waives any right to seek damages of any kind.
risk_reason: Waiving all rights to damages and limiting remedy to termination only is extremely one-sided.

clause_text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflict of law principles.
risk_reason: Standard, neutral governing law clause commonly used in commercial contracts.

clause_text: Any assignment of this Agreement by either party requires prior written consent of the other party, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
risk_reason: Balanced assignment clause with a reasonableness standard for consent.

clause_text: Company may assign this Agreement to any third party at its sole discretion without Client's consent, including in the event of a merger or acquisition.
risk_reason: One-sided assignment rights without requiring counterparty consent can shift obligations unexpectedly.
